title: Table
description: Rows and columns of data such as orders, with header, footer, caption and an empty state; a wide table scrolls in its box and takes keyboard focus to do so.

components.Table: Groups all parts of the table, which shows data in rows and columns.
components.TableBody: Holds the data rows of the table.
components.TableCaption: Describes in a short line what the table shows.
components.TableCell: Holds one value in a row of the table.
components.TableEmpty: Shows a message in place of rows when the table has no data.
components.TableFooter: Holds the summary rows at the bottom of the table, such as totals.
components.TableHead: Labels one column of the table.
components.TableHeader: Holds the row of column labels at the top of the table.
components.TableRow: Groups the cells that belong to one entry of the table.
